segments.title: Chương 230: 0231 [Có tiền thật sự có thể làm mưa làm gió]
segments.content:
"Wow, are they shooting a movie?"

Li Yulin wanted to get closer, but was blocked by a crew member.

Chen Guiliang also felt it would be rude to interrupt, so he stood and watched from a distance.

He had long since been demystified by directors and actors, but this film carried memories of his youth.

This was the first movie he'd ever seen in a theater in his past life!

"Crazy Stone" was almost finished filming, and the scenes at Luohan Temple were part of the wrap-up.

The very last scene being shot was of the male lead, Bao Shihong, having a mental breakdown in the bathroom after the jade was repeatedly swapped out.

"Hey! Close the main gate!"

Guo Tao, who played the male lead, threw his cigarette butt down hard and turned to run toward the Luohan Temple gate.

The other actors also grabbed various props and ran with him, while another actor frantically closed the gate.

There were two high-definition digital cameras filming on site.

It was quite a poor production.

But not so poor that they were using a DV camera as the newspapers claimed. Besides the two HD digital cameras, some shots in the film were also done on film stock.

"Cut!"

The director had the actors reset, and they shot it again.

Then he adjusted the camera positions to film additional details.

Chen Guiliang and the others just stood there watching for twenty minutes, and no one suggested leaving.

They were all watching with great interest.

It was the same principle as watching an excavator at work.

"Thank you so much, sorry for the trouble." The director shook hands with the firefighters.

The fire station was just next door, and after this scene was done, the fire engine had to leave.

The chase scene inside the temple had been filmed last night.

The next scene wouldn't be until midnight, after the surrounding shops had turned off their lights and there were no more cars or pedestrians on the road. It was the shot of Huang Bo climbing out of the sewer for the first time.

The scenes inside the sewer had been filmed long ago, on a set built over at Chaotianmen.

Liu Hua, who played the gang leader Dao Ge, had even wrapped up his scenes early and left the set a few days ago.

"Come over and have some barbecue!" the director beckoned and shouted.

The barbecue grill was brought over from a nearby vendor, who had been standing by, watching the fun.

The next scene was for Huang Bo and Yue Xiaojun. The other actors could have wrapped up for the day, but the director kept everyone around for barbecue.

They couldn't just wait around doing nothing.

"Director Ning!"

Chen Guiliang finally couldn't resist showing himself.

This movie was his youth. He would truly be disappointed if he didn't get a cameo.

Since they weren't actively filming or preparing to film, the crew members didn't stop him this time.

Ning Hao turned around, puzzled, "And you are?"

Chen Guiliang smiled and shook his hand, handing over a business card. "A while back, your main creative team all joined Haineiwang. And Tudouwang bought the exclusive online rights to 'Crazy Stone'. I own both of those companies."

"Ah, it's President Chen, a pleasure, a pleasure!" Ning Hao's face instantly broke into a smile.

Guess how much the exclusive online rights for "Crazy Stone" sold for?

Only three thousand yuan!

Feng Kuzi's "The Banquet" could only sell for 100,000 yuan this year.

However, to invite the main creative team to join Haineiwang, ByteDance had also paid a two-thousand-yuan sponsorship fee.

In other words, Ning Hao got five thousand—the three-thousand-yuan online copyright fee, though paid to the copyright holder, ultimately ended up being used by Ning Hao for filming.

Chen Guiliang said, "I was just shopping nearby with a friend and happened to see you filming. I watched for a bit, it's very interesting. I'm even thinking of playing a passerby."

"That's easy," Ning Hao was quick on the uptake. "Does President Chen have any specific requests for the role?"

"As long as I can show my face, I'll play anything," Chen Guiliang said.

Xiao Jun from the trio of clumsy thieves was one of the screenwriters for the film.

He suggested, "If President Chen is in a hurry, he can play a security guard. In the earlier shot of closing the gate, President Chen can be in a security guard uniform, chatting behind the gate. When you hear Brother Bao yell to close the gate, you just grab a club and run inside. We only need to add a one-second shot."

The matter was both simple and complicated.

The lighting crew and everyone else got busy.

But Ning Hao was very enthusiastic about it. The film's budget was limited, and the promotional funds were even tighter.

Having an internet up-and-comer make a cameo in the film could serve as a promotional gimmick.

"Thanks," Chen Guiliang smiled. "Director Ning, if your next film is short on funds, feel free to come find me at ByteDance."

Ning Hao was overjoyed. "Then I won't be shy."

Then, Ning Hao said, "Let me make some introductions. This is Mr. Guo Tao, the male lead of our film."

"I've long admired your name, I saw you in 'To Live'," Chen Guiliang shook Guo Tao's hand, spouting nonsense. "The last time I had dinner with Mr. Yu Hua, he even said what a great actor Mr. Guo Tao is."

Guo Tao looked surprised. "Mr. Yu Hua praised my acting?"

"Haha, your acting is superb," Chen Guiliang replied ambiguously.

Ning Hao then introduced Huang Bo, Liu Gang, and other actors.

"I know Huang Bo, you played a migrant worker, right? What was the name of that film again?" Chen Guiliang said.

Huang Bo replied, "'Get in the Car, Let's Go'."

"Right, right," Chen Guiliang said. "My roommate watched it in our dorm, and I sat next to him and watched it too."

Chen Guiliang chatted with them for a bit and also introduced his own friends.

Guan Zhiqiang asked with great interest, "Can I get a cameo too?"

Ning Hao nodded. "Sure. You can both wear security uniforms and lean against the wall inside the Luohan Temple gate, just chatting. When you hear the commotion, grab your weapons and run inside."

Chen Guiliang and Guan Zhiqiang eagerly ran off to put on the security guard uniforms.

The clothes had just been taken off by the previous actors and smelled of sweat.

Chen Guiliang was taller and Guan Zhiqiang was a bit heavy, so neither security uniform fit well.

But that just happened to create a comical effect.

Ning Hao studied them carefully. "President Chen is too handsome. You can put on the security hat. Yes, wear it crookedly, otherwise you'll still steal the scene."

So Chen Guiliang wore the security hat askew. Bian Guanyue couldn't help but laugh, "You look like a puppet army soldier from the movies now."

"Even if I'm a puppet army soldier, I'm one of the good guys who's infiltrated their ranks," Chen Guiliang pointed at Guan Zhiqiang and said, "This guy looks like a translator who'd lead the Japanese invaders."

Guan Zhiqiang wasn't offended at all. Instead, he bowed and scraped, stooping over as he said to Chen Guiliang, "Your Excellency, this way please."

"Hahahaha!"

This time, even Yang Shuo, who was acting as a bodyguard, was amused.

Ning Hao said, "This friend has a real talent for acting. We can collaborate if there's a chance in the future."

"Really?"

Guan Zhiqiang's eyes lit up. He took out his phone and said, "Director, let's exchange numbers. You can pay me whatever, just let me act."

Ning Hao didn't know whether to laugh or cry. He had just said it casually, but now he had no choice but to exchange numbers with Guan Zhiqiang.

They didn't start rolling right away. Chen Guiliang and Guan Zhiqiang rehearsed it first.

It was just a one or two-second thing. The two of them would lean against the wall chatting, and when they heard "Close the main gate!" from outside, they would immediately grab their weapons and run inside.

Chen Guiliang even added to his own role, designing a move where he nearly tripped as he started running.

Guan Zhiqiang copied him, deliberately not setting his hat straight so he'd have to hold it to keep it from falling off as he ran.

The other actors were all outside eating barbecue.

Liu Gang, the actor who played San Bao, pointed inside, "They're having a lot of fun."

The actor who played the effeminate security guard said, "The rich are here to experience life. We're all just playing along with them."

Huang Bo said, "If we get on good terms with this President Chen, we can promote the movie on his website. The director is also doing this for work."

Guo Tao asked, "What does his website do? Someone helped me set up some kind of mobile Weibo, but I've already forgotten how to use it."
